question: From whom may a practitioner accept alms as part of disciplined observance?
premises: Living on alms is an option.
Alms may come from those born in good families.
Alms may come from the twice-born.
inference: A practitioner may subsist on alms received from good families or the twice-born.
plain_english: Or one may live on alms from those born in good families or from the twice-born.
